title: Verify parcel divert/sort confirmation message is received to track tote contents
summary: After a parcel sorts down to a chute location and into a tote, a divert confirm or sort confirmation chat message is triggered. This message is critical for tracking: without it, the system does not know where the parcel went or what is in the tote. This runbook provides a live-system check to confirm the confirmation message is received and that the software associates the parcel to the tote location in the rack.
when_to_use: Use when you need to verify that a parcel’s divert/sort confirmation chat message was received after the parcel sorts down to a chute location and into a tote, so the system can record the parcel’s destination and tote contents.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Perform the live check that the divert confirm / sort confirmation chat message is received for the parcel lifecycle moment (sort down to chute into tote) and confirm the software’s tote association behavior.
access_or_tools_needed: Chat interface/logs where divert confirm or sort confirmation messages appear (as referenced by the source)

access_required: Access to the chat interface/logs used for divert confirm / sort confirmation messages
system_preconditions: A parcel has reached the lifecycle moment where it sorts down to a chute location and into a tote

visual_references.description: Training video frame showing the parcel lifecycle moment (sort down to chute location and into a tote) and stating that the next chat message is a divert confirm or sort confirmation and is critical for tote tracking.

steps.title: Identify the parcel lifecycle moment (sorted down to chute location and into a tote)
steps.purpose: The confirmation message check must be tied to the lifecycle moment when the parcel has sorted down to a chute location and into a tote.
steps.instruction: Confirm the parcel has reached the lifecycle moment described as: it sorts down to a chute location and into a tote.
steps.expected_result: You can identify that the parcel has sorted down to a chute location and into a tote (the point at which the next chat message should be triggered).
steps.healthy_condition: The parcel lifecycle has progressed to the chute-and-tote stage (i.e., the system is at the point where the divert confirm / sort confirmation chat message is expected).
steps.failure_condition: The parcel has not reached the chute-and-tote stage, so a divert confirm / sort confirmation chat message would not be expected yet.

actions.label: Confirm chute-and-tote lifecycle stage
actions.exact_action: Identify the parcel lifecycle moment: a parcel sorts down to a chute location and into a tote.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Oh, so parcel was sort down to a shoot location and into a tote. This triggers the next message from the chat where it tells us… divert, confirm or sort confirmation.”
Near 00:23:58, transcript states the chat message (divert confirm or sort confirmation) is critical; without it you don’t know where it went or what’s in the tote.

steps.title: Check for the next divert confirm / sort confirmation chat message
steps.purpose: Verify the critical chat message is received after the parcel sorts down into a tote, enabling tote tracking.
steps.instruction: In the chat interface/logs, check whether the next chat message is received that indicates a divert confirm or sort confirmation for the parcel lifecycle moment (sort down to chute location and into a tote).
steps.expected_result: A divert confirm or sort confirmation chat message is received for the parcel.
steps.healthy_condition: The divert confirm / sort confirmation chat message appears after the parcel has sorted down to the chute location and into a tote.
steps.failure_condition: The divert confirm / sort confirmation chat message is not received after the parcel reaches the chute-and-tote stage.

actions.label: Verify confirmation chat message received
actions.exact_action: Check whether the next chat message is received that indicates a divert confirm or sort confirmation.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the divert/sort confirmation message is not received, because the system then cannot determine where the parcel went or what is in the tote.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “This triggers the next message from the chat where it tells us… divert, confirm or sort confirmation. This message is pretty critical because if we don't get it, we don't actually know where it went or we don't know what's in the tote.”

steps.title: Confirm software associates the parcel to the tote location in the rack
steps.purpose: Validate the source-backed behavior that once sorted to the destination, the software adds the parcel to the tote location in the rack (tote contents tracking).
steps.instruction: After the divert confirm / sort confirmation chat message is received, confirm that the software adds the parcel to the tote location in the rack.
steps.expected_result: The software adds the parcel to the tote location in the rack (tote tracking is updated based on the confirmation).
steps.healthy_condition: Tote tracking reflects that the parcel is associated with the tote location in the rack after the confirmation message is received.
steps.failure_condition: Even though the parcel reached the chute-and-tote stage, the software does not associate the parcel to the tote location in the rack (tote tracking does not reflect the parcel).

actions.label: Verify tote association in software
actions.exact_action: Confirm the source-backed behavior: software adds the parcel to the tote location in the rack.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “So once it's sorted to that destination, the software adds A parcel to the tote location in the rack.”

success_criteria: A divert confirm or sort confirmation chat message is received for the parcel after it sorts down to a chute location and into a tote.
Software associates the parcel to the tote location in the rack (tote contents tracking is updated).
healthy_conditions: Divert confirm / sort confirmation chat message appears for the parcel lifecycle moment (sort down to chute location and into a tote).
Software adds the parcel to the tote location in the rack after sorting to the destination.
failure_conditions: Divert confirm / sort confirmation chat message is missing after the parcel sorts down to the chute location and into a tote.
Software does not add the parcel to the tote location in the rack after sorting to the destination.
escalation_guidance: Escalate if the divert/sort confirmation chat message is not received, because the system then cannot determine where the parcel went or what is in the tote.
